scripts.predev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/validation && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && npm run build -w @repus/email-renderer && npm run build -w @repus/import-storage
scripts.dev: node tools/run-with-env.cjs concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @repus/api" "npm run dev -w @repus/web"
scripts.preworker: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/validation && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && npm run build -w @repus/email-renderer && npm run build -w @repus/import-storage
scripts.preevent-worker: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/validation
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/shared-types && npm run build -w @repus/validation && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && npm run build -w @repus/email-renderer && npm run build -w @repus/import-storage && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pretest: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/validation && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && npm run build -w @repus/email-renderer && npm run build -w @repus/import-storage
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && node tools/run-with-env.cjs --worker-db playwright test
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @repus/shared-types && npm run build -w @repus/validation && npm run build -w @repus/token-security && npm run build -w @repus/email-renderer && npm run build -w @repus/import-storage && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:inner: npm run test:launcher && npm run test:load:guards && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
